Match this Hashtag symbol Jibbitz™ charm with Crocs’ varsity-style letters to embody your favorite tags.

Representing the balance between positive and negative, the yin yang is a traditional Chinese symbol that makes a great Jibbitz™ charm. Wear it yourself to show that you’re ready for anything, or gift it to a friend whose friendship you value.

Brighten your days and put your optimism on full display with this Rainbow Jibbitz™ charm. It’s the perfect pop of color to accent any wardrobe and pairs perfectly with Crocs’ new Rainbow Collection of footwear styles. It also makes great gift for anyone who knows how to be comfortable in their own shoes.

What’s in your heart? Pair this I Heart Jibbitz™ charm with any of Crocs’ other charms and show the world who and what you truly love. It’s a great way to express yourself and personalize your favorite pair of Crocs™ clogs or slides.
Celebrate the U.S. Virgin Island of St. Thomas on your Crocs™ clogs or slides with this St. Thomas Flag Jibbitz™ charm.
Celebrate the island of St. Maarten on your Crocs™ clogs or slides with this St. Maarten Flag Jibbitz™ charm.
Peace, dude. This Peace Hand Sign Jibbitz™ charm will show the world that you like to be cool and casual.
This adorable Pineapple Jibbitz™ charm shows that you love one of nature’s sweetest and juiciest fruits. Classic yellow and green go with any style during any season.
Yum! This delectable Watermelon Jibbitz™ charm channels summer snacks and carefree feelings. A slice of watermelon with a bite taken out is just what you need to round out your breezy summer look.

Save the galaxy with your favorite Space Ranger. This classic Buzz Lightyear Jibbitz™ charm is the perfect addition to any pair of Crocs™ clogs or slides!

© Disney/Pixar

"There’s a snake in my boot!" Hopefully not, but this Jibbitz™ charm will show off your love for Woody, the hero of Disney and Pixar’s Toy Story.

© Disney/Pixar

Personalize your clogs and show off your affection for this favorite bakery confection, the hole-y donut! This Pink Donut Jibbitz™ charm will keep you in a sweet state of mind and draw smiles and compliments throughout the day.
Simple and classic, the heart symbolizes love and friendship. A rounded style and bright red coloring make this charm a pure joy!
Harness the luck o’ the Irish with this four-leaf Clover Jibbitz™ charm! A classic rounded style and kelly green coloring make this charm a sure bet.
Gamers of the world, this Jibbitz™ charm is just for you! Show the world that video games are a part of you with this Grey Game Controller charm.

You can now add the Peanuts® Woodstock® Jibbitz™ charm to your favorite Crocs™ clogs or slides to show off your love of this iconic comic. Pick up the Snoopy® and Charlie Brown® charms to bring more of the gang with you on every step. 

© 2019 Peanuts Worldwide LLC

Happy dance! You can now add the Peanuts® Snoopy® Jibbitz™ charm to your favorite Crocs™ clogs or slides to show off your love of this iconic comic. Pick up the Charlie Brown® and Woodstock® charms to bring more of the gang with you on every step. 

© 2019 Peanuts Worldwide LLC
Bring the relaxing feeling of the tropics to your Crocs™ clogs or slides with this Palm Tree charm. Pair it with the Big Wave Jibbitz™ charm for an even more relaxing beach vibe.
A summertime favorite! Add some fun, fruity flair to your Crocs™ clogs or slides with the Peach Jibbitz™ charm.

Show off your passion for this legendary tale of witchcraft and wizardry with this Harry Potter Logo Jibbitz™ charm. Create an even more complete Harry Potter theme when you combine it with any or all of the Hogwarts Houses Jibbitz™ charms.

HARRY POTTER characters, names and related indicia are © & TM Warner Bros. Entertainment Inc.
If something is cool, you might say it’s "fire" — like this charm! Add the Fire Jibbitz™ charm to your Crocs™ clogs or slides for a truly scorching style statement.

Take the Mushroom Kingdom by storm with this lovable set of Jibbitz™ charms from Crocs! Includes the Super Mario™, Luigi™, Princess Peach™, Bowser™ and Yoshi™ Jibbitz™ charms.

TM & © 2020 Nintendo.  All Rights Reserved.

Have a Coke® and a smile. And some Jibbitz™ charms.

Part of Hello Kitty’s 50th Anniversary Collection, this Hello Kitty 5-Pack is an iconic must-have for fans. Pop them into your Classics and keep making the world a cuter place! © 2024 SANRIO CO., LTD. Used Under License. Not a toy. Not intended for children under 3 years of age.

Show off your love of Disney’s mischievous and adorable Experiment 626 with this fun set of Jibbitz™ charms! Each pack includes 5 charms celebrating the tropical homeland of Lilo and Stitch. Not a toy. Not intended for children under 3 years of age.

Let your style really speak for itself with a Jibbitz™ charm speaker that plays any sound you record. Simply press and hold the button, sing, speak or record a sound, then play it back until you’re ready to make a new one. Perfect for Valentine’s Day, birthdays, or any special occasion. Not a toy. Not intended for children under 3 years of age.

Pedal to the metal! Light your way when you flip on your Headlight Jibbitz™ charms. Choose from three light modes to really rev up your style. Not a toy. Not intended for children under 3 years of age.
